Details 
 The Mezcal combines legendary Stetson quality with a heritage western profile that truly stands tall in the saddle. It’s crafted from our proprietary 6X fur felt, which is prized for its durability and elegant feel, and, as with all hats that come out of our factory in Texas, each Mezcal is touched by more than 100 sets of hands during production, resulting in a hat that is designed and built to stand the test of time. It has a 5” tall cattleman crown, 4” heavy curved brim and is finished with a matching self-felt band and engraved three-piece, silver-tone buckle. A handsewn genuine leather sweatband and full satin liner provide a time-tested fit and premium comfort.
- 5" Tall Cattleman Crown
- 4" Heavy Curved Brim
- Matching Self-Felt Hatband
- 3-Piece Silver-Tone Buckle
- Genuine Leather Sweatband
- Full Satin Liner
- Original Stetson Hat Box
- 6X Quality Fur Felt
- Handmade in the U.S.A.
